title: Glucose tolerance test
what: This test checks how your body handles sugar. Blood is taken while fasting, and again 2 hours after you drink a glucose solution.
why: If diabetes or prediabetes is suspected, and usually for all pregnant women at 24 to 28 weeks.
duration: about 2 to 2 and a half hours at the clinic
tell_doctor: If you already have diabetes or high blood sugar
If you are pregnant, and how many weeks
If you were recently ill, had surgery, or had a lot of stress

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: No food for 10 to 14 hours before the test. Water is fine.

prepare.title: 3 days before
prepare.text: Eat as usual. Do not diet, or the result will be wrong.

prepare.title: In the morning
prepare.text: Do not smoke or chew gum. Bring a book. You will wait a long time.

bring: Water and a snack for after the test
steps: First, blood is taken while you are fasting
You drink a glass of sweet glucose solution within 5 minutes
For two hours you sit quietly at the clinic: no eating, no smoking, no brisk walking
After 2 hours, blood is taken again
feel: The drink is very sweet and may make you a little sick. Take small sips
Sometimes you feel weak toward the end of the wait
after: You can eat after the second blood draw
Results usually come in 1 to 2 days. Your doctor will explain them
red_flags: Strong weakness, sweating, or shaking: tell the nurse right away

faq.q: Can I go for a walk during the test?
faq.a: Better not. Moving changes your blood sugar. Stay seated at the clinic.

faq.q: What if I throw up after the glucose drink?
faq.a: Tell the nurse. The test will most likely be moved to another day.

reminders.text: Glucose tolerance test tomorrow. Stop eating now. Water is fine.
Test soon. Bring water, a snack for later, and something to keep you busy for 2 hours.
